findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_meeting_space" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_venue, request_office_quotes, request_meeting_space, get_request_status · Private data: get_booking_links, get_venue, city_prices · Public sink: get_booking_links, request_office_quotes, request_meeting_space, confirm_email_code, get_request_status, request_viewing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_venue, request_office_quotes, request_meeting_space, get_request_status · Private data: get_booking_links, get_venue, city_prices · Public sink: get_booking_links, request_office_quotes, request_meeting_space, confirm_email_code, get_request_status, request_viewing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
